defaults.rationale: Explicit small-case information-isolation bench setting; not a calibrated NOA or paper parameter.

parameters.name: sensor_roundoff_ulps
parameters.rationale: Snap box comparisons within 8 ULP of the largest configured range (2.274e-13 m at 200 m); numerical inclusive-boundary policy only, not measurement noise or a physical range extension.

parameters.name: memory_horizon_s
parameters.rationale: Only prior measured observations in the last second; no refresh outside range; reentry gets a new local track.
